column1: # Full-stack words (depth/pick/roll) — GRADUATED 2026-08-03 for exact
# top-level stacks (checker-compiler-completeness-review.0.md §8.2(2)):
# EmitState.FoldFullStack statically folds the dispatch when the simulated
# stack is provably exact — depth bakes the count as a concrete const,
# pick re-pushes the picked entry (an event target is promoted to a
# value-def local), roll re-seats the true permutation — so the elided
# dispatch needs no opcode and no event. The graduated rows moved to
# lang/spec/corpus-core.tsv where the census owns them.
# The permuting roll GRADUATED with the forty-third increment
# (2026-09-10): the program residual now REBUILDS when its order is not
# the order the events produced it in — every simulated-stack entry
# spills to a frame local and the residual is pushed back exactly as
# recorded (seatResidualRebuild, the program-residual twin of the
# call-site spillSeat). The rows joined lang/spec/corpus-core.tsv.
# The CODE-BODY class SPLIT with the fifty-second increment (2026-09-11).
# The fold's exactness condition is per-UNIT: a compiled body unit has its
# own stack discipline exactly as the top unit does, and `depth` inside a
# body counts the BODY's stack on both lanes. So the CONST/LOCAL occurrence
# folds now and lives in lang/spec/corpus-core.tsv.
# The EVENT-PRODUCED occurrence below does not, and the reason is not
# exactness — it is that a body unit has no residual REBUILD. The top unit
# can take a permuted residual (seatResidualRebuild spills every entry to a
# frame local and re-pushes it in the recorded order, the forty-third
# increment); a body unit's residual seating refuses a result that lands
# above a literal. Folding a permutation there turns this sound island into
# a REFUSAL, which is backwards — measured, by the variation differential,
# on the first cut of this very increment.
# Graduation = the residual rebuild inside a body unit. The row below is the
# variation ledger's representative for the "islanded" bucket.
[10 20] each [drop (1 add 2) (3 add 4) 1 pick]
